biggest_catch: Tigerfish publishes no pay rate anywhere on its official site, and as of 2026-09-23 its official applicants page says it currently has no openings for transcriptionists at all — so there is no way to earn anything through it right now, and no official figure to verify.
catches: No pay rate, pay-per-unit, or pay schedule is published on any official Tigerfish page — the official applicants and transcription-jobs pages mention nothing about compensation.
The official applicants page (tigerfish.com/applicants/) states: 'We currently do not have openings for transcriptionists. Please check back.' — you cannot even apply right now.
Zero guaranteed tasks: work is per-assignment gig work; nothing on the official site promises any volume of work.
You must pass their qualification test (three ~5-minute audio segments per their official test instructions) before any work; test alone can take weeks to be reviewed, per third-party reports.
Effective hourly pay cannot be estimated from official sources and is reported as low (~$0.005/word, ~$7-15/hr) by third parties only — never confirmed officially.
Variable task availability: work depends on client orders and is never guaranteed or scheduled.

Third-party sources report Tigerfish requires accepted transcribers to purchase proprietary playback software (~$200-229); this could NOT be confirmed on any official page I read — treat as unverified.

c1.evidence: Tigerfish Transcribing and Editing — real company, in business since 1989 (official applicants page: 'Tigerfish has been in business since 1989'), client testimonials from Cisco, Intel, Haas Jr. Fund on the official site.

c2.evidence: Official 'Transcription Application' page at tigerfish.com/applicants/ exists, but states 'We currently do not have openings for transcriptionists. Please check back.' The opportunity is real but not currently open.

c3.evidence: No upfront participation fee is stated on any official Tigerfish page read. Third-party sources claim a ~$200-229 software purchase is required after acceptance — could not be confirmed officially, so no confirmed upfront fee.

c4.evidence: No official Tigerfish page publishes any pay figure or pay mechanism: the applicants page and the official transcription-jobs test instructions contain zero compensation information. Third-party worker reports (~$0.03-0.04/line, ~$7-10/hr) are not official.

eligibility: Officially: no current openings for transcriptionists ('Please check back'). Historical third-party requirements (US citizen/resident, 18+, Windows PC, style-guide test) could NOT be confirmed on the official pages I read — the official test instructions only describe emailing a transcription test to inbox@tigerfish.com.
notes: Read live: tigerfish.com/applicants/ (opened, full text — 'no openings', in business since 1989, client testimonials) and the search-result text of tigerfish.com/transcription-jobs/ (test work order: three 5-minute segments, email to inbox@tigerfish.com; mentions 'our clients have strict budgets for what they can afford to pay' but gives no rate). Could NOT confirm on official pages: any pay rate, pay method, pay timing, country/age requirements, or the reported ~$200-229 mandatory software purchase. The catalog claim of $0 payout could not be upgraded — there is no official pay figure to verify against.
